column1: # Subsystems registered by GameEngine::init (0x00079060), in registration order.
# Recovered mechanically from the binary: walk init's push/call stream, split at
# each "TheXxx" string literal that feeds StringBase<char>::StringBase(const char*),
# and read back the preceding operator-new size + constructor, or the factory call
# when the subsystem is not new'd.
# Order is INI override precedence. TheSubsystemLegend is first so everything after
# it can look itself up; only TheWritableGlobalData and TheVictorySystem are handed
# hard-coded INI paths, so the other 58 load solely through SubsystemLegend.ini.
# ctor_or_factory / init_template are RVAs. sizeof is what retail passes to
# operator new. Each subsystem has its own initSubsystem<T> instantiation, ~192
# bytes apiece, laid out consecutively from 0x00072DD0 — 60 more matchable
